title: RAW_UNSCREENED: Conditional diagnosis with an ordered polarity reversal
summary: Celsus gives a compact diagnostic chain with acute/chronic alternatives, a conditional fallback, a first restraining and then warming/drawing treatment, and a named final preparation. This supplies a branch plus changed outcome consequence for an admitted Herbal line, beyond repeated words.

design.mechanism: A clinical paragraph encodes observation, diagnosis branch, conditional fallback, ordered interventions and endpoint; the interventions can reverse a property while preserving the patient/complaint frame.
design.external_primary: Celsus, De Medicina 4.15.1.1, Packard Humanities Institute: https://latin.packhum.org/loc/836/2/260
design.source_example: Celsus separates acute from longer liver disease by signs; gives bloodletting first; says the abdomen is to be loosened if necessary; then orders external poultices, first those that restrain and then warm ones that draw, followed by a malagma. The conditional and the ordered polarity pair are explicit.
design.target_endpoint: The already admitted complete Herbal line f29v.4 from GDT625: `ysho otshy okaiin cthy oltchy s shot sho okaiin`; f29v.1 is the paired complete local line in the same registered source report.
design.reading_a: A diagnostic/process record: a condition selects one branch, two successive interventions alter a shared carrier in opposite directions, and a final endpoint closes the case.
design.reading_b: A descriptive part-state record: the apparent polarity pair is two co-present material states or parts, with no diagnosis, conditional branch, or temporal result.
design.observable_difference: Reading A predicts one independently recurrent condition slot before a branch, a stable ordered pair of opposite state changes on the same carrier, and a distinct terminal endpoint; reversing the pair changes the clinical result. Reading B predicts no branch-dependent choice and allows the two state/part fields to co-occur without an endpoint transition. No English action is assigned in advance.
design.smallest_test: Use only the existing f29v.1/f29v.4 complete lines and frozen boundaries. Seek a repeated condition-before-branch frame and a held polarity/order consequence; a mere dry/moist adjacency or assigned carrier is insufficient.
design.nearest_rival: GDT625's two parallel plant-part/state descriptions, including its preferred reading of f29v.4.
assumption_costs: Celsus supplies a content architecture, not a Voynich translation.
Condition, carrier and endpoint must be independently coded rather than borrowed from old glosses.
The source's polarity order must be treated as a falsifiable relation, not as a synonym list.
design.strongest_likely_failure: The admitted lines expose no written condition or independent result, so process and inventory readings can be relabelled to fit the same surfaces.
